subject: Fix session.js active-claim: t.agent_id → t.assignee (unblocks subagent gate)
description:
Fix a one-line bug in /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid/routes/session.js.

Line 16 maps `agent_id: t.agent_id` but buildGraph returns tasks with `.assignee` not `.agent_id`. This means the subagent_session lookup at line 30 (`state.agents[t.agent_id]?.subagent_session === sid`) always hits `state.agents[undefined]` = undefined, so subagent claim checking never works.

Fix: change line 16 from:
  let all = g.tasks.filter((t) => t.status === 'in_progress').map((t) => ({ key: t.id, label: t.label, session: t.session, agent_id: t.agent_id }));
To:
  let all = g.tasks.filter((t) => t.status === 'in_progress').map((t) => ({ key: t.id, label: t.label, session: t.session, agent_id: t.assignee }));

After making this fix, re-dispatch task #34 (bench-journal-agent) to complete the bench journal wiring work. Task #34 was started but blocked by this gate bug.
